changelog:
Initial release of Ambiguity Resolver

- Transforms vague or unclear briefs into structured, actionable one-page problem statements.
- Guides users through a three-stage process: Reframe (questions & assumptions), Scope (in/out boundaries, decision owner, timing), and Action (targeted research plan).
- Produces a clear output format with restated questions, scoped boundaries, stakeholder accountability, and a minimum viable research plan.
- Includes example brief and strong anti-patterns/quality checks to ensure clarity and actionable outcomes.
